newsitem.title: USA: Key Tronic sees gradual earnings, rev gains.
newsitem.headline: Key Tronic sees gradual earnings, rev gains.

text.p: Key Tronic Corp said Tuesday it expects gradual earnings and revenue growth in the second quarter based on current customer projections.

Earlier, the company reported a $0.02 per share profit in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 versus a profit of $0.16 a share one year ago. But the company had reported two straight quarters of losses preceding the first quarter report.

In a statement, Key Tronic noted the transfer of production to a low cost plant in Mexico from a plant in Ireland helped produce the profit. An expanded customer base also contributed to the profit, the company said.
"Prospects are good for the addition of new computer original equipment manufacturers to the company's customer base during the second half of fiscal 1997," the company said.
Lastly, Key Tronic added it is working on new products to generate growth and an improving product mix.
